text: de-pluralize user-facing strings so no plural layer is ever needed

Done in 4efe880. Eight sites, not seven — the notification poster carries a second count in the same string ('N items changed across M lists'), found while editing. formatLastSeen was made to match its existing sibling formatBackgroundSync (T-112) rather than inventing a format: it already read '20 min ago / 3 h ago / 2 d ago' on the same Settings screen, and abbreviated units never inflect in any language. Web dropped Intl.RelativeTimeFormat as part of this — it gave correct plurals for free but different wording from Android, and the clients are deliberately kept in step; the four unit labels become ordinary catalog entries in T-111. Also fixed a latent trap in ListPage: its toast auto-dismiss compared endsWith(newCategory), which the reworded message would have silently broken; it now compares the whole message, which is what it always meant.
